notes: Ask SideCut is a regular labelled button in the header now - under the bell, the sync and the Settings gear, and bigger than all of them. The floating bubbles are gone.
One button, one place: it sits in the header on every screen the header shows, with the same sparkle and the same drawer it always had.
The drawer can make an album from a sentence: "create an album called MooseTape with all Sidhu Moose Wala songs" plans the selection, counts it, and creates the album when you tap Do it.
No dialog and no keyboard: the album is filed under its one artist, or under Various Artists when the songs come from more than one.
Naming an album the library already has adds only the songs it is missing, so nothing ever lands twice.
The plan undoes like any other: albums go back exactly as they were, including one this run created.
